name: Windhoek
subtitle: Windhoek, capital of Namibia: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 494,605 people live in Khomas Region, whose urban core is Windhoek (counted 2023).
Windhoek was founded on 18 October 1890, when Major Curt von François laid the foundation stone of the Alte Feste fort for the German protective corps (Schutztruppe).
The first recorded settlements grew up because of the hot springs; Nama and Herero names for the place referred to them.

parts.text: Windhoek was founded on 18 October 1890, when Major Curt von François laid the foundation stone of the Alte Feste fort for the German protective corps (Schutztruppe).
The first recorded settlements grew up because of the hot springs; Nama and Herero names for the place referred to them.
The modern name is not settled: the city says some believe Jonker Afrikaner named it after the Winterhoek Mountains near Tulbagh, South Africa.
The Nama name /Ai-//Gams means Fire Water and the Herero name Otjomuise means Place of Steam; both referred to the hot springs.
Development quickened after 1907 as more settlers arrived from Germany and South Africa.
Windhoek is the capital of Namibia and is run by a municipality established under the Local Authority Act of 1992.

parts.text: 494,605 in 2023, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Total population of Khomas Region at the 2023 Population and Housing Census (NSA).

items.text: Orlam Captain Jan Jonker Afrikaner settles at the strongest spring in what is now Klein Windhoek.
Von François lays the foundation stone of the fort; the city dates its founding to this day.
During the 1904 Herero war the Alte Feste serves as barracks and shelter for women and children.
Faster growth as settlers arrive from Germany and South Africa.
South African troops occupy Windhoek on behalf of Britain, ending German colonial rule.
Police shoot into a protest against forced removal from the Old Location to Katutura; 11 people are killed.
The Old Location is officially closed after residents are resettled in Katutura.
Independence brings considerable investment to the city centre.

blocks.q: Myth or fact: Windhoek simply means 'windy corner' in Afrikaans.
blocks.explain: The origin is disputed. The City of Windhoek says some believe Jonker Afrikaner named it after the Winterhoek Mountains in South Africa. Older Nama and Herero names referred to the hot springs.
